---
title: "Explore Gridworld value iteration"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

Value iteration finds the optimal state values by repeatedly applying a greedy
Bellman update. For each state, compare the immediate reward plus the
discounted value of the resulting state, then keep the largest result.

$$
V_{k+1}(s) = \max_a \left[r(s,a,s') + \gamma V_k(s')\right],
\qquad \gamma = 0.9.
$$

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Start with all values equal to zero. Each sweep updates all 25 states using
the **previous** value grid. Click a state to see how its next value is
computed. Value iteration does not maintain a policy between sweeps; the
greedy policy is extracted from the values after they converge.
:::

<div id="gridworld-value-iteration-explorer" class="gridworld-policy-iteration-explorer gridworld-value-iteration-explorer" aria-label="Interactive Gridworld value iteration explorer">
  <div class="gridworld-iteration-toolbar clt-buttons" aria-label="Value iteration controls">
    <button id="gridworld-value-reset" type="button">Reset values</button>
    <button id="gridworld-value-step" class="gridworld-iteration-primary" type="button">One Bellman sweep</button>
    <button id="gridworld-value-run" type="button">Run to convergence</button>
    <output id="gridworld-value-status" class="gridworld-iteration-status" aria-live="polite">Sweep 0</output>
  </div>

  <div class="gridworld-iteration-workbench">
    <section class="gridworld-iteration-panel gridworld-iteration-value-panel" aria-labelledby="gridworld-value-heading">
      <div class="gridworld-iteration-panel-heading">
        <h2 id="gridworld-value-heading">Current value estimates</h2>
        <p>The current value grid starts at zero and changes with each sweep.</p>
      </div>
      <div id="gridworld-value-value-grid" class="gridworld-iteration-grid gridworld-iteration-value-grid" role="grid" aria-label="Gridworld state value estimates"></div>
      <div class="gridworld-iteration-legend" aria-label="Value color legend"><span>Lower value</span><i></i><span>Higher value</span></div>
    </section>

    <section id="gridworld-value-backup-panel" class="gridworld-iteration-panel gridworld-value-backup-panel" aria-labelledby="gridworld-value-inspector-heading">
      <div class="gridworld-iteration-panel-heading">
        <h2 id="gridworld-value-inspector-heading">Next backup at one state</h2>
        <p id="gridworld-value-selected">Selected state: (2, 2)</p>
      </div>
      <div class="gridworld-iteration-table-wrap">
        <table class="gridworld-iteration-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Action</th><th>Next state</th><th>Reward</th><th><i>r</i> + γ<i>V</i><sub>k</sub>(<i>s</i>′)</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody id="gridworld-value-actions"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <p id="gridworld-value-result" class="gridworld-value-result" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </section>

    <section id="gridworld-value-policy-panel" class="gridworld-iteration-panel gridworld-iteration-policy-panel" aria-labelledby="gridworld-value-policy-heading" hidden>
      <div class="gridworld-iteration-panel-heading">
        <h2 id="gridworld-value-policy-heading">Greedy policy</h2>
        <p>Best actions from the converged values.</p>
      </div>
      <div id="gridworld-value-policy-grid" class="gridworld-iteration-grid gridworld-iteration-policy-grid" role="grid" aria-label="Actions greedy with respect to the converged values"></div>
      <p class="gridworld-iteration-grid-note">All tied best actions are shown.</p>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section class="gridworld-iteration-reading" aria-labelledby="gridworld-value-reading-heading">
    <h2 id="gridworld-value-reading-heading">How to read a sweep</h2>
    <ol>
      <li>For each action, add its immediate reward to the discounted value of the next state.</li>
      <li>Keep the maximum for each state; calculate all new values from the same previous grid.</li>
      <li>Once the largest change in a sweep falls below 0.0001, extract the greedy policy.</li>
    </ol>
  </section>
</div>
